name: ClawChat
releaseNotes: Publishes the stabilized ClawChat private messenger build. Live audio/video calling is removed for stability; messaging, attachments, chat sessions, delivered/read receipts, local notifications, and embedded Syncthing encrypted sync remain.
description: ClawChat is an Android-first private messenger for no-phone-number chat. It creates a local cryptographic identity, pairs devices with invites, syncs encrypted message events through embedded Syncthing, supports attachments, delivered/read receipts, local notifications, and keeps live calling disabled for stability.
